title: Ashby (YC W19) Is Hiring EMEA Engineers Who Can Design
summary: Ashby, a Y Combinator Winter 2019 company, is actively recruiting full-stack engineers across EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa) regions who possess design capabilities alongside engineering skills.
problem_solved: This is a job posting, not a technical project solving a specific problem.
why_valuable: Provides a remote job opportunity for engineers interested in combining design and development work at a YC-backed company.
